title: Ilumina DNA Prep Part 2 - Post Tagmentation Cleanup
author: Opentrons
materials: Sample plate is being place on magnetic module

steps.title: Transfer TSB and mix
steps.instruction: Transfer 5 µL of TSB from the mastermix plate to each well of the sample plate using fresh tips, then mix slowly.

steps.title: Place plate on magnet
steps.instruction: Place the sample plate onto the magnetic module.

steps.title: Engage magnet
steps.instruction: Activate the magnetic module to engage the magnet.

steps.title: Incubate
steps.instruction: Wait for 5 minutes to allow bead capture.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Aspirate and discard 30 µL of supernatant from each well.

steps.title: Disengage magnet
steps.instruction: Deactivate the magnetic module to disengage the magnet.

steps.title: Add TWB and resuspend
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL of TWB to each well, then mix 15 times at the bead location to resuspend the beads.

steps.title: Engage magnet
steps.instruction: Reactivate the magnetic module to engage the magnet.

steps.title: Repeat wash twice
steps.instruction: Perform the following sequence two additional times: remove 50 µL supernatant, disengage magnet, add 50 µL TWB, mix 15 times at the bead location, and re‑engage magnet.

steps.title: Add TWB and resuspend
steps.instruction: Add another 50 µL of TWB to each well and mix 15 times at the bead location to resuspend the beads.

steps.title: Add EPM mastermix
steps.instruction: Pipette EPM mastermix into columns 3 and 4 of the Bio‑Rad 200 µL plate as indicated.

steps.title: Engage magnet
steps.instruction: Activate the magnetic module to engage the magnet.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Aspirate and discard 50 µL of supernatant from each well.

steps.title: Add EPM and resuspend
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL of EPM to each well and mix 15 times at the bead location to resuspend the beads.

steps.title: Transfer index and mix
steps.instruction: Transfer 5 µL of index to each sample well and mix 10 times.
